fact: The government launched the project to set up an e-GP platform under the GEPRES project, said to cover planning to payment; Finance Minister Carla Louveira launched it.
The Ministry of Economy page of 3 April 2025 says the government launched the e-GP electronic public procurement project, to be delivered in phases.
UFSA says the Ministry of Economy and Finance launched the Concurso por Lances e-auction procurement mode on 12 March 2021, run on the e-SISTAFE platform, with a first live tender of nine bidders.
